dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature, following a non-linear spline that recedes anteriorly from the base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is acute with a small pixel-radius rounding at the tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge follows a near-linear slope at an approximate 65-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible fin base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.25:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of small nicks/irregularities along the trailing edge margin and irregular light-colored patches across the lateral surface of the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Mottled skin pigmentation and high specular highlights indicating a wet surface texture.
